name: CACZ
name_zh: 深圳常安创智科技有限公司
summary: CACZ is a Shenzhen developer of robot-joint motor drives and specialized electric drives, power modules and sensors. Its robotics portfolio comprises compact, high-power compact, hollow and high-power hollow joint drivers. The company offers custom development for robotics and AGV applications and separately supplies high-temperature equipment for demanding industrial environments.
categories: Robot Control Boards and Computing Components
